create_fastagent_app: create a FastAgent application with a name string for an MCP server test
define_agent_with_decorator: define an agent using the fast.agent decorator with name, instruction, and servers parameters
run_agent_interactive: run the agent in interactive mode using the fast.run context manager
call_tool_anonymously: call an MCP tool anonymously using agent.anon with a CALL_TOOL command string
apply_prompt_with_params: apply a named prompt to an agent with keyword arguments as parameters
